item.title: Trump considers building U.S. warships in Korea… Presidential office: "Under impression it's not ruled out" (트럼프, 미 군함 한국서 짓나… 청와대 “배제하지 않는 인상 받아”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung held follow-up discussions on warships with President Donald Trump at the NATO summit, and on the 9th (local time), the presidential office stated, "I am under the impression that (President Trump) is not excluding the option of building ships in Korea, but we may need to look into that aspect a bit further." (이재명 대통령이 나토 정상회의에서 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 군함 관련 후속 협의를 한 가운데 청와대는 9일(현지시각) “(트럼프 대통령이 선박을) 한국에서 건조하는 것도 배제하지 않는 것 같은 인상을 저는 받고 있는데, 그 부분을 조금 더 파악을 해봐야 할 것 같다”고 말했다.)

A senior presidential official made this remark during a briefing in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, where President Lee is on a state visit, in response to reporters' questions about "whether the request from the Trump administration involves building entire warships at Korean shipyards or manufacturing blocks in Korea for assembly locally." ( 청와대 고위 관계자는 이날 이 대통령이 국빈 방문 중인 몽골 울란바타르 현지 브리핑에서 ‘트럼프 정부가 요청하는 것이 한국 조선소에서 군함 전체를 건조하는 형태인지, 한국에서 블록을 제조해 현지에서 조립하는 형태인지’를 묻는 기자들의 질문에 이같이 말했다. )

The senior official added, "President Trump's interest in shipbuilding is not new today; this issue has been discussed since the G7 summit. Since it was a brief conversation while standing at a dinner, the entire content is not perfectly coherent but somewhat fragmented. We need to flesh out the details through working-level consultations and identify and fill in any gaps we don't know about." ( 이 고위 관계자는 “선박 건조에 대한 트럼프 대통령의 관심이 오늘 처음이 아니고 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 때부터 이 사안에 대한 거론이 있었다”며 “만찬장에서 잠시 서서 나눈 대화였기 때문에 전체 내용이 딱 들어맞는다기보다는 조금 조각조각들이다. 실무협의를 좀 더 하면서 구체화시키고, 또 우리가 알지 못하는 공간을 좀 파악해서 채워내야 한다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, on the 7th, at the NATO summit held in Ankara, Turkey, President Lee met with President Trump during a reception and welcome dinner hosted by Turkish President Erdoğan and his wife, conducting follow-up discussions related to South Korea's warship construction. This meeting occurred three weeks after President Lee had met with President Trump at the G7 summit in Évian, France, last month. At that time, President Lee had disclosed that President Trump asked, "Can you quickly build 10 U.S. warships?" leading to these subsequent consultations. ( 앞서 이 대통령은 지난 7일 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열린 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의에서 에르도안 튀르키예 대통령 내외 주최 리셉션 및 환영 만찬에서 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 만나 한국의 군함 건조와 관련한 후속 협의를 진행했다. 이 대통령은 지난달 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 이후 3주 만에 트럼프 대통령을 만났다. 당시 이 대통령은 트럼프 대통령이 “미국 군함 10척을 신속히 건조할 수 있느냐”고 물은 사실을 공개했는데, 이와 관련한 후속 협의가 이뤄진 것이다.)

Additionally, regarding the U.S. State Department's recent expression of serious concerns about the amended Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection (Network Act) implemented in South Korea, the presidential office stated, "There has been appropriate communication between Korea and the U.S., but we may need to provide further explanations." The senior presidential official said, "We are not engaging in discriminatory actions; we are taking reasonable measures to protect consumer interests. Through communication, we aim to secure our interests." ( 아울러 청와대는 미국 국무부가 최근 한국에서 시행된 개정 정보통신망법(정통망법)에 관해 심각한 우려를 표한 데 대해서는 “한미간 적절한 소통이 있었는데, 우리가 좀 더 설명을 해야 할 것 같다”고 말했다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “우리가 차별적인 행위를 하는 게 아니라 우리가 소비자 이익을 수호하기 위해 합당한 조치를 하는 것이기 때문에 소통을 하면서 이익을 획득해 나가려고 한다”고 말했다.)

The amended Network Act, which took effect on the 7th, primarily stipulates that media outlets, YouTubers, and others who distribute illegal information or false manipulated content causing harm to others may be liable for damages up to five times the amount of the harm. In response, the U.S. State Department had stated that it has "serious concerns that it could lead to excessive content regulation and undermine freedom of expression." ( 지난 7일부터 시행된 개정된 정통망법은 언론사, 유튜버 등이 불법정보나 허위조작정보를 유통해 다른 사람에게 손해를 끼치면 손해액의 최대 5배까지 배상 책임을 지도록 하는 내용이 골자다. 이를 두고 미 국무부는 “과도한 콘텐츠 규제를 초래하고 표현의 자유를 훼손할 수 있다는 점에 대해 심각한 우려를 갖고 있다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Ulaanbaatar / Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 울란바타르/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Police Replacement Can Be Demanded if Supplementary Investigation Is Not Conducted… Investigation Period Capped at Maximum Two Months (보완수사 안하면 경찰 교체 요구 가능…수사기한 최대 2개월로)
item.description:
The amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act proposed by the Democratic Party of Korea on the 9th aims to completely abolish the prosecution's investigative powers, including the right to request supplementary investigations, thereby separating investigation from prosecution. Instead, the focus is on strengthening the effectiveness of the prosecution's right to demand supplementary investigations from judicial police officers. (더불어민주당이 9일 발의한 형사소송법 개정안은 보완수사권을 비롯한 검사의 수사권을 전면 폐지해 수사와 기소를 분리하고, 대신 사법경찰관에 대한 검사의 보완수사요구권 등의 실효성을 강화하는 것이 핵심 내용이다.)

According to the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, which was discussed by the Democratic Party's task force (TF) and proposed on this day by Kim Han-kyu, the party's senior deputy chief of policy coordination, Article 196, which regulates the prosecution's investigation of police-submitted cases, has been deleted. This is intended to align with the abolition of the Supreme Prosecutors' Office on October 2 and the establishment of the Public Prosecution Office (responsible for indictment and maintaining prosecution) and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office (responsible for investigation), providing a legal basis for the complete separation of investigation and prosecution. (민주당 형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF) 논의를 거쳐 이날 김한규 민주당 원내정책수석부대표가 대표발의한 형사소송법 개정안을 보면, 경찰의 송치 사건에 대한 검사의 수사를 규정한 196조 등을 삭제했다. 오는 10월2일 검찰청이 폐지되고 공소청(기소·공소유지)과 중대범죄수사청(수사)이 신설되는 것에 맞춰 수사와 기소를 완전 분리하는 법적 근거를 마련한 것이다.)

As a result, the prosecution's right to request supplementary investigations will be eliminated. The current provision (Article 197-2, Paragraph 2), which states that "police officers shall, without justifiable reasons, promptly carry out supplementary investigations," has been amended by deleting the phrase "without justifiable reasons." For police officers who fail to conduct supplementary investigations, the types of sanctions that prosecutors can demand have been expanded from the existing removal from duty and disciplinary action to include "replacement" (Article 197-2, Paragraph 4). However, this provision still includes a clause that applies only "without justifiable reasons," which could reduce the effectiveness of strengthening the prosecution's right to request supplementary investigations. (이에 따라 검사의 보완수사권이 사라진다. ‘경찰관은 정당한 이유가 없는 한 지체 없이 보완수사를 이행한다’는 현행 조항(197조2의 2항)에서 ‘정당한 이유가 없는 한’을 삭제했다. 보완수사 불이행 경찰관에 대해 검사가 요구할 수 있는 제재 종류는 기존 직무배제와 징계에 ‘교체’가 추가(197조2의 4항)됐다. 다만 이 조항에는 ‘정당한 이유 없이’ 보완수사를 이행하지 않을 경우란 단서가 남았다. 검사의 보완수사요구권 강화에 실효성이 떨어질 수 있는 대목이다.)

The Democratic Party's proposal also specifies the duration for supplementary investigations and reinvestigations. A new provision (Article 197-2, Paragraph 3) states that "supplementary investigations must be completed within one month from the date of receiving the request." The period can be extended only once by up to one month if there are "reasonable grounds." Currently, the enforcement decree sets the deadline for fulfilling a supplementary investigation request at within three months, but the amendment stipulates a firm "one month plus one month" period by law. For cases not transferred to the prosecution, if the prosecution requests a reinvestigation, the police are required to complete it within three months. This is intended to address delays in cases resulting from the prosecution's requests for supplementary investigations or reinvestigations. Deputy Chief Kim said, "Since the investigation period following a request for supplementary investigation is explicitly set at one month, it will enable faster investigations." (민주당 안에선 보완수사와 재수사 기간도 명시했다. ‘보완수사 요구를 받은 날로부터 1개월 안에 마쳐야 한다’는 조항(197조2의 3항)이 신설된 것이다. ‘상당한 이유’가 있으면 1개월 범위에서 한차례만 기간을 연장할 수 있다. 현재는 시행령으로 보완수사 요구 이행 시한을 3개월 이내로 규정하는데, 개정안은 법으로 ‘1개월+1개월’을 못박았다. 불송치 사건에 검사가 재수사를 요청할 경우 경찰은 3개월 안에 재수사를 마치도록 명시했다. 검찰의 보완수사·재수사 요구에 따른 사건 지연 실태를 개선하겠다는 취지다. 김 수석부대표는 “보완수사 요구 뒤 수사 기간을 1개월로 명시했기 때문에 신속한 수사가 가능해지리라 생각한다”고 말했다.)

A new element in the Democratic Party's amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act is a provision (Article 197-3, Paragraph 7) that allows for the transfer of a case to another investigative agency if the fairness of the investigation is in doubt. This is meant to change the investigative body in cases where police negligence or unfairness is confirmed, such as in the "Gwangju high school student murder case." Rep. Park Sang-hyuk, who participated in the Democratic Party's TF for the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, said on the same day, "Even if the right to request supplementary investigations remains, cases like that of Jang Yun-gi won't disappear. It's necessary for the investigative agencies to self-correct and be checked by preventing interested parties from getting involved in investigations." (민주당의 형소법 개정안에서 새롭게 등장한 내용은 수사의 공정성이 의심될 경우에 다른 수사기관에 사건을 이송할 수 있다는 조항(197조3의 7항)이다. ‘광주 고교생 피살 사건’처럼 경찰의 부실·불공정 수사가 확인된 경우 수사 주체를 바꾸게 하겠다는 것이다. 민주당 형소법 개정 티에프에 참여한 박상혁 의원은 이날 “보완수사권이 존치한다고 해서 장윤기 같은 사건이 없어지는 게 아니다. 경찰에서 이해관계자가 수사에 관여하는 것을 막는 방식으로 수사기관 자정과 견제가 필요한 것”이라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party's TF, which led the proposal, stated, "We will ensure that the Legislation and Judiciary Committee conducts swift and thorough deliberations so that the implementation of the Public Prosecution Office Act and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office Act proceeds without disruption, and we will strive to create an investigative and judicial system that benefits the people." The Democratic Party plans to refer the amendment directly to the first subcommittee of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 10th, where it will be jointly reviewed with two pending amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act (proposed by Reps. Kim Yong-min and Park Eun-jung, and Rep. Cha Kyu-geun). The Democratic Party intends to speed up the review process by holding subcommittee meetings once or twice a week going forward. (개정안 발의를 주도한 민주당 형소법 개정 티에프는 “법사위에서 신속하고 면밀히 심의해 공소청법과 중수청법 시행에 차질이 없도록 하고, 국민들에게 도움이 되는 수사·사법 제도를 만들도록 노력하겠다”고 밝혔다. 민주당은 개정안을 10일 법사위 법안심사 1소위원회에 직회부해 현재 계류 중인 형사소송법 개정안 2건(김용민·박은정 의원안, 차규근 의원안)과 병합 심사할 예정이다. 민주당은 향후 소위원회를 주 1~2회씩 개최해 심사 속도를 내겠다는 방침이다.)

item.title: President and First Lady Make Surprise Visit to 'Seoul Street' in Mongolia (이 대통령 부부, 몽골 ‘서울의 거리' 깜짝 방문)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, on a state visit to Mongolia, visited 'Seoul Street' in Ulaanbaatar on the 9th (local time), warmly interacting with Mongolian citizens, including high-fives. (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령과 김혜경 여사가 9일(현지시각) 울란바타르의 ‘서울의 거리’를 찾아 몽골 국민들과 하이파이브를 하는 등 반갑게 소통했다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong said in a written briefing that when the presidential couple arrived at Seoul Street that evening, Mongolian citizens greeted them warmly with phrases like "Hello" and "Nice to meet you." The presidential couple shook hands and responded with high-fives. Seoul Street was created in 1995 following the sister-city relationship between Seoul and Ulaanbaatar. It features Korean brands, restaurants, and 'Seoul Pavilion,' a traditional Korean-style pavilion. ( 이 대통령 부부는 이날 저녁 서울의 거리에 도착하자 몽골 국민들은 “안녕하세요” “반갑습니다” 등 인사를 건네며 따뜻하게 맞이했다고 안귀령 부대변인이 서면브리핑을 통해 전했다. 이 대통령 부부는 몽골 국민들과 악수하고 하이파이브로 화답했다. 서울의 거리는 1995년 서울과 울란바타르의 자매결연을 계기로 조성된 거리다. 한국 브랜드와 음식점 등이 들어서 있고, 한국 전통양식의 정자인 ‘서울정’이 세워져 있다.)

After looking around from the Seoul Pavilion, the presidential couple bought and tasted gimbap, tteokbokki, and dumplings from a nearby street vendor. The couple said, "It's delicious," and asked if Mongolian people like tteokbokki. The vendor replied, "It's especially popular among young people," and added, "The dumplings are also Korean products." The president also expressed delight upon seeing Korean-language signs like 'Pork.' ( 이 대통령 부부는 서울정에 올라 주변을 둘러본 뒤 인근 노점에서 파는 김밥과 떡볶이, 만두 등을 직접 구입해 맛봤다. 이 대통령 부부는 “맛있다”며 몽골 국민들이 떡볶이를 좋아하는지 물었다. 그러자 상인은 “특히 젊은이들 사이에서 인기가 많다”며 “만두도 한국 제품”이라고 소개했다. 또 이 대통령은 ‘돼지고기’ 등 한국어 간판을 보고는 반가움을 나타내기도 했다.)

The presidential couple ended their schedule that day by having dinner of dubu kimchi, grilled mackerel, and bibimbap at 'Goraebul,' a Korean restaurant run by Mongolian citizens. Deputy Spokesperson Ahn said, "The couple's surprise visit was a meaningful time to directly witness the long-standing exchanges between the two countries, naturally communicate in the daily lives of Mongolian citizens, and further strengthen friendship and trust." ( 이 대통령 부부는 몽골 국민이 운영하는 한식당 ‘고래불’에서 두부김치와 고등어 구이, 비빔밥으로 저녁 식사를 하고 이날 일정을 마무리했다. 안 부대변인은 “이 대통령 부부의 깜짝 방문은 오랜 시간 이어져온 양국 교류의 현장을 직접 확인하고, 몽골 국민들의 일상 속에서 자연스럽게 소통하며 우호와 신뢰를 한층 다지는 뜻깊은 시간이었다”고 말했다.)

Ulaanbaatar/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 울란바타르/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [View Briefing] Despite Top Committee’s Decision… Conflict Within Democratic Party over ‘Preferential Voting System’ ([뷰리핑] 전준위 판단 불구…민주 내부 ‘선호투표제’ 갈등)
item.description:
Host: Ha Eo-ying, Hankyoreh political team reporter. Guests: Park Jin-young, political commentator; Kim Man-kwon, political philosopher; Han Sang-jin, News Tapa journalist (진행: 하어영 한겨레 정치팀 기자. 출연: 박진영 정치비평가, 김만권 정치철학자, 한상진 뉴스타파 기자)

Top committee had already decided, but… Jung Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok clash over ‘preferential voting system’ / Kim Eo-jun, parting ways with Jung Cheong-rae? The story behind releasing ‘CCTV footage from martial law day’? / ‘Museopno debate’ spreading into political circles, clearly summarized / Democratic Party revives position of youth supreme council member after 8 years / ‘Self-staged assault’ suspect Jung Yi-han continues election campaign even after confessing / Kim Hyung-oh says, “Jang Dong-hyuk must resign responsibly, Han Dong-hoon should give up party leadership” / Was Yoon Seok-yeol more Yoon Seok-yeol than expected? item.title: President Lee on ‘IKEA parental leave retaliation’ allegations: “Cannot tolerate anti-labor practices” (이 대통령, ‘이케아 육아휴직 보복’ 의혹에 “반노동 용납 못해”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, currently on a state visit to Mongolia, stated on the 10th (local time), “Just as our companies should not engage in anti-labor, irrational behavior abroad, foreign companies should not do so in Korea either.” (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 10일(현지시각) “우리 기업도 해외에서 반노동 비상식 행태를 보여서는 안 되는 것처럼 외국기업도 국내에서 그래선 안 된다”고 말했다.)

President Lee made these remarks while sharing a report on X (formerly Twitter) that said, “Allegations have been raised that global furniture company IKEA Korea demoted an employee who returned from parental leave and pressured them to resign, prompting an investigation by the Ministry of Employment and Labor.” (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 ‘글로벌 가구 기업 이케아(IKEA) 코리아가 육아휴직을 쓰고 돌아온 직원의 직급을 강등하고 권고사직을 종용했다는 의혹이 제기돼 고용노동부가 조사를 진행하고 있다’는 보도를 공유하며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee said, “There were times in the past when model global companies, which were exemplary in other countries, caused criticism by engaging in anti-labor and opaque management practices particularly in Korea. That was during an era when our government pursued anti-labor policies and was plagued by corruption. But now, Korea is transforming into a model society and model government leading the world. If such outdated management practices occur, I cannot tolerate them.” (이 대통령은 “한때 다른 나라에선 모범적인 글로벌 기업이 유독 우리나라에서만 반노동적이고 불투명한 경영을 해서 빈축을 사는 경우가 있었다”며 “우리나라 정부가 반노동 정책을 구사하고 부정부패로 물들어 있던 시절의 이야기지만, 이제는 대한민국이 세계를 선도하는 모범 사회·모범 정부로 거듭나고 있는데 그러한 구태경영 행태가 발생한다면 용납할 수 없다”고 말했다.)

President Lee added, “We will conduct a thorough investigation, and if the allegations are proven true, we will take strict measures in accordance with international standards.” (이 대통령은 그러면서 “철저히 조사해서 사실로 밝혀진다면 국제적 기준에 맞게 엄정하게 조치하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Ulaanbaatar/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (울란바타르/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeong Jeom-sik: "Acting Interior Minister and Acting Police Commissioner Should Resign Over the 'Jang Yun-gi' Case" (정점식 “행안장관·경찰청장 대행, ‘장윤기 사건’ 책임지고 사퇴하라”)
item.description:
The People Power Party on the 10th demanded that "Interior Minister Yoon Ho-jung and Acting Police Commissioner Yoo Jae-sung should take responsibility and resign" over allegations of negligent investigation and collusion in the "Gwangju high school student murder case." (국민의힘은 10일 ‘광주 고교생 살인 사건’ 부실 수사·수사 유착 의혹에 대해 “윤호중 행정안전부 장관과 유재성 경찰청장 직무대행은 이번 사태에 대한 책임을 지고 사퇴하라”고 요구했다.)

Jeong Jeom-sik, the People Power Party floor leader, stated at the party's floor strategy meeting held at the National Assembly that "this is a shocking case where the police destroyed evidence for a murderer" and that "if a serious offender who committed a rape-murder can have his crime downplayed and evidence erased due to his father being a policeman, this cannot be called a normal country." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 당 원내대책회의에서 “경찰이 살인자를 위해 증거를 인멸한 경악스러운 사건”이라며 “강간살인 사건을 저지른 중범죄자가 경찰인 아버지의 배경으로 범죄를 축소하고 증거를 없애는 일이 가능하다면 정상적인 나라라고 할 수 없다”고 했다.)

Jeong expressed regret over the Gwangju Metropolitan Police's refusal of a protest visit by party leader Jang Dong-hyuk the previous day, saying, "This isn't just about this case; since the Yoon Seok-youl administration, police organizational discipline has weakened. The Interior Ministry bears primary responsibility." He added, "President Yoon's responsibility is far from small for running the police under an unstable acting commissioner system without appointing a permanent police chief. I strongly urge President Yoon to promptly appoint a permanent police commissioner." (정 원내대표는 전날 장동혁 대표의 항의 방문을 거부한 광주경찰청에 유감을 표하며 “이번 사건뿐만 아니라 이재명 정부 들어 경찰의 조직 기강이 해이해졌다. 일차적으로 행정안전부의 책임”이라고 했다. 이어 “정식 경찰청장을 임명하지 않고 불안정한 직무대행 체제로 경찰을 운영해 온 이재명 대통령의 책임이 결코 작지 않다”며 “이 대통령은 정식 경찰청장을 조속히 임명할 것을 강력 촉구한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the Democratic Party's proposal the previous day to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority and amend the Criminal Procedure Act, Jeong said, "We propose convening a ruling-opposition-government consultative table for reforming investigative agencies, including measures to check the police's complete monopoly over investigative powers." (더불어민주당이 전날 발의한 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 형사소송법 개정안 발의에 대해서는 “경찰의 수사권 완전독점 견제 방안을 포함한 수사기관 개혁을 위한 여·야·정 협의테이블 개최를 제안한다”고 했다.)

item.title: 57% Say Three Major Megaprojects ‘Help Regional Balance,’ 26% Say ‘Widen Gap Further’ [Gallup] (3대 메가프로젝트 ‘지역 균형 도움’ 57%, ‘격차 더 확대’ 26% [갤럽])
item.description:
A poll released on the 10th found that 57% of respondents gave a positive assessment that the so-called “three major megaprojects”—large-scale investment plans in advanced industries such as semiconductors and artificial intelligence (AI)—“will help with balanced regional development.” (반도체·인공지능(AI) 등 첨단산업 대규모 투자 계획인 이른바 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’가 ‘지역 균형 발전에 도움이 될 것’이라는 긍정 평가가 57%에 달한다는 여론조사 결과가 10일 나왔다.)

According to a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 7th to the 9th among 1,002 people nationwide (with a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, via telephone interviews), regarding the impact of the three major megaprojects, 57% responded that they “will help with balanced regional development,” while 26% said they “will widen the gap between regions.” 17% withheld their opinion. (한국갤럽이 지난 7∼9일 전국 1002명을 대상으로 실시한 여론조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 전화면접조사) 결과를 보면, 3대 메가프로젝트 영향과 관련한 조사에서 ‘지역 균형 발전에 도움될 것’이란 응답이 57%, ‘지역 간 격차가 더 커질 것’이라는 답변이 26%로 집계됐다. 17%는 의견을 유보했다.)

By region, opinions were evenly split only in Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province (39% saying it helps regional balance, 37% saying it widens regional gaps), while in all other areas, more respondents expected balanced development. By political orientation, 85% of progressives, 61% of moderates, and 34% of conservatives viewed it positively. (권역별로 보면 대구·경북(지역균형 도움 39%·지역 간 격차 확대 37%)에서만 긍정·부정 의견이 비등했고, 다른 전 지역에서는 균형 발전 기대에 대한 응답이 많았다. 성향별로 보면 진보층 85%, 중도층 61%, 보수층 34%가 긍정적으로 내다봤다.)

Approval of President Lee Jae-myung’s job performance stood at 53%, with disapproval at 35%. In last week’s survey (June 30 to July 2), approval was 54% and disapproval was 36%. (이재명 대통령 직무수행에 대한 긍정평가는 53%, 부정평가는 35%였다. 지난주(6월30일∼7월2일) 조사에선 긍정 54%, 부정 36%였다.)

In terms of party support, the Democratic Party of Korea stood at 42% and the People Power Party at 24%. Last week, they were 41% and 26%, respectively. The Democratic Party of Korea has maintained around the low 40% range over the past month, while the People Power Party has seen a downward trend for three consecutive weeks. The Rebuilding Korea Party and the Reform Party each received 3%, and the Progressive Party and the Basic Income Party each received 1%. The proportion of unaffiliated voters was 26%. (정당 지지도는 더불어민주당이 42%, 국민의힘이 24%였다. 지난주엔 각각 41%, 26%였다. 더불어민주당은 최근 한 달 동안 40%대 초반을 유지했고, 국민의힘은 3주 연속 내림세를 보였다. 조국혁신당·개혁신당이 각각 3%, 진보당·기본소득당이 각각 1%였다. 무당층은 26%로 나타났다.)

For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다.)

item.title: Presidential Office to Hold ‘National Public Debate on Real Estate’ on the 23rd, Discussing Reforms to Holding Taxes and Transaction Taxes (청와대, 23일 ‘부동산 국민 대토론회’…보유세·거래세 개편도 논의)
item.description:
The Presidential Office announced that it will hold a ‘National Public Debate on Real Estate Policy’ on the 23rd, with President Lee Jae-myung personally attending, to discuss various opinions presented so far and explore policy directions. During this debate, plans to reform the real estate tax system are also expected to be discussed. (청와대가 오는 23일 이재명 대통령이 직접 참석하는 ‘부동산 정책 국민 대토론회’를 개최해 그동안 제시된 다양한 의견을 함께 논의하고 정책 방향을 모색하겠다고 밝혔다. 이번 토론회에선 부동산 세제 개편 방안도 논의가 될 것으로 전망된다.)

Kim Yong-beom, Chief of the Presidential Office’s Policy Office, stated at a briefing at the Chunchugwan of the Presidential Office that day, “We do not believe that real estate policy can be completed solely through the government’s judgment. What is needed now is not for the government to unilaterally present answers, but for the public and experts to create solutions together,” explaining the decision to hold the debate. (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 이날 청와대 춘추관 브리핑에서 “부동산 정책이 정부의 판단만으로 완성될 수 있다고 생각하지 않는다”며 “지금 필요한 것은 정부가 일방적으로 답을 제시하는 것이 아니라, 국민과 전문가가 함께 해법을 만들어가는 과정”이라며 토론회를 개최하겠다고 밝혔다.)

To this end, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Financial Services Commission, and the Ministry of Economy and Finance will first hold open debates on the topics of supply, finance, and taxation from the 14th to the 16th of this month to hear opinions from experts and the public. Subsequently, at the debate on the 23rd attended by President Lee, personnel from the Presidential Office including Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik and Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, as well as Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yoon-cheol, ministers from relevant ministries such as the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Financial Services Commission, experts, and ordinary citizens will participate. (이를 위해 먼저 이달 14~16일까지 국토교통부, 금융위원회, 재정경제부가 각각 공급, 금융, 세제를 주제로 공개 토론회를 열어 전문가와 국민의 의견을 들을 예정이다. 이후 23일 이 대통령이 참석하는 토론회에는 강훈식 비서실장, 김용범 정책실장 등 청와대 인사들과 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관, 국토부, 금융위 등 관계부처 장관 및 전문가, 일반 국민 등이 참석하게 된다.)

Chief Kim said, “We will also widely listen to the opinions of citizens who cannot attend the debate. We will set up an online opinion-gathering channel so that anyone can freely present their opinions regardless of time or location, and the submitted opinions will be thoroughly reviewed and faithfully reflected in the debate discussions and policy review process.” (김 실장은 “토론회에 참석하지 못하는 국민들의 의견도 폭넓게 듣겠다”며 “온라인 의견수렴 창구를 마련해 시간과 지역에 관계없이 누구나 자유롭게 의견을 제시할 수 있도록 하고, 접수된 의견은 충분히 검토해 토론회 논의와 정책 검토 과정에 충실히 반영하겠다”고 말했다.)

The government’s preparation of the real estate debate is not unrelated to the recent continuous rise in real estate prices. According to the Korea Real Estate Board, sales prices in Seoul have been on the rise for 74 consecutive weeks since the first week of February last year. Chief Kim stated, “Housing is the most directly connected issue to the lives of the people. The burden and anxiety over home prices, jeonse and monthly rents, loans, and homeownership are difficulties that many people feel in their daily lives. The government also takes this market situation seriously and is reviewing policies with the public’s housing stability as the top priority.” (정부가 부동산 토론회를 마련한 것은 최근 이어지고 있는 부동산 가격 상승과 무관치 않다. 한국부동산원에 따르면 서울 매매가격은 지난해 2월 첫째 주 이후 74주 연속 상승세를 이어가고 있다. 김 실장은 “주거는 국민의 삶과 가장 직결된 문제”라며 “집값과 전월세, 대출과 내 집 마련에 대한 부담과 불안은 많은 국민이 일상에서 체감하는 어려움이다. 정부도 이러한 시장 상황을 무겁게 받아들이고 있으며, 국민의 주거 안정을 최우선에 두고 정책을 점검하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Chief Kim continued, “The government has been promoting policies based on the principles of expanding supply and stabilizing the market. Supply plans are being carried out without disruption, and regarding concerns over overheating in certain areas, such as the recent designation of land transaction permit zones in Dongtan, Giheung, and Guri, we are implementing necessary market stabilization measures in parallel.” (김 실장은 이어 “정부는 그동안 공급 확대와 시장 안정이라는 원칙하에 정책을 추진해 왔다”며 “공급 계획은 차질 없이 추진하고 있으며, 최근 동탄·기흥·구리 등에 대한 토지거래허가구역 지정 등과 같이 일부 지역의 과열 우려에 대해서는 필요한 시장 안정 조치를 병행하고 있다”고 말했다.)

He also stated that tax reform plans are under review. Chief Kim added, “Furthermore, we are reviewing reasonable improvement plans for the overall tax system, including holding taxes and transaction taxes, based on research results and overseas cases.” (세제 개편 방안도 검토하고 있다고 밝혔다. 김 실장은 “아울러 보유세와 거래세 등 세제 전반에 대해서도 연구용역 결과와 해외 사례 등을 토대로 합리적인 개선 방안을 검토하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Han Dong-hoon Expelled for Criminal Acts… Demand for Leader’s Resignation Is Subtraction Politics" (장동혁 “한동훈은 범죄행위로 제명…대표 사퇴 요구가 뺄셈정치”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, directly mentioned independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, stating, “The party member bulletin board issue is a criminal act. Lawmaker Han was expelled not for party-affiliated acts but for criminal acts.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 한동훈 무소속 의원을 직접 거론하며 “당원 게시판 문제는 범죄행위다. 한 의원은 해당행위가 아니라 범죄행위로 제명당한 것”이라고 말했다.)

Appearing on New Daily TV’s YouTube channel on the 10th, Representative Jang said, “Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon was expelled for criminal acts, not for party-affiliated acts. Regarding the permanent ban on readmission for those committing party-affiliated acts, I hope critics will consider what act led to Han’s expulsion before criticizing.” The People Power Party expelled Han in January over suspicions that Han posted on the party member bulletin board articles criticizing former President Yoon Suk-yeol and his wife. ( 장 대표는 10일 뉴데일리티브이(TV) 유튜브에 출연해 “한동훈 의원은 범죄행위로 제명을 당한 것이지, 해당행위로 제명당한 것이 아니다. 해당 행위자 복당 영구 금지에 대해선 한 의원이 어떤 것으로 제명당했는지 생각해보고 비판하면 좋겠다”고 밝혔다. 국민의힘은 지난 1월 당원게시판에 한 의원이 가족들이 윤석열 전 대통령 부부 비판 글을 올렸다는 의혹과 관련해 한 의원을 제명한 바 있다.)

Earlier, on the 6th, Representative Jang stated in a closed supreme council meeting, “Serious party-affiliated acts need to be addressed by amending the party constitution and rules to permanently ban readmission.” As interpretations emerged that this target Han, Jang denied it while emphasizing that the reason for Han’s expulsion was a “criminal act.” ( 앞서 장 대표는 지난 6일 비공개 최고위원회의에서 “심각한 해당 행위는 당헌·당규를 개정해서라도 복당을 영구 금지할 필요가 있다”고 밝힌 바 있다. 한 의원을 겨냥한 발언이라는 해석이 나오자, 이를 부인하면서도 한 의원 제명 사유가 ‘범죄행위’라고 강조한 것이다.)

Representative Jang explained that the “permanent ban on readmission” was a comment aimed at those who left the party to run as independents during local elections. He elaborated, “What many lawmakers demanded of me was to send a strong message that anyone who leaves to run as an independent should be permanently banned from readmission. That way, they wouldn’t support that person but back our party’s candidate.” He added, “If someone leaves to run as an independent, we act like we’ll impose strong discipline and expel them, but eventually during presidential or general elections, they get readmitted, so no one fears expulsion or readmission bans.” ( 장 대표는 ‘영구 복당 금지’는 지방선거 과정에서 탈당하고 무소속 후보로 출마한 사람들에 대한 발언이었다고 설명했다. 그는 “많은 의원이 저한테 어떤 요구를 했냐면, 탈당해 무소속으로 출마한 사람에 대해 영원히 복당을 금지한다고 강하게 메시지를 내야 한다. 그래야 이 사람(무소속 후보)을 돕지 않고 우리 당 후보를 돕게 된다”고 설명했다. 그는 “탈당해 무소속 출마하면 강하게 징계하고 제명할 것처럼 했다가 결국 대선·총선 때 복당을 받아주기 때문에 제명당하거나 복당 금지하는 거에 대해서 아무도 두려워하지 않는다”고 했다.)

Regarding his recent emphasis on disciplining those committing party-affiliated acts to “establish party discipline,” Representative Jang asked, “Can we call someone who helps the enemy in a war our ally?” He stated, “Victory in war is not determined by the number of soldiers. What matters more is whether the organization can unite in a single formation to fight together.” He also said, “They tell me not to engage in subtraction politics, but pointing a gun at our own side is the biggest minus. There is no greater subtraction than that. Demanding that the leader step down is subtraction politics.” He added, “Clear party-affiliated acts are like pointing a gun at our own side in a war and helping the enemy.” ( 장 대표는 최근 ‘당의 기강 확립’을 위해 해당행위자에 대한 징계를 강조한 것 관련 “전쟁에서 적을 돕는 사람을 우리 편이라고 할 수 있나”라며 “전쟁에서 승리는 많은 병사의 숫자로 하는 것이 아니다. 단일 대오로 뭉쳐 힘을 모아 싸울 수 있는 조직인지가 더 중요하다”고 했다. 또 “뺄셈 정치를 하지 말라고 하는데, 우리 편을 향해서 총을 쏘는 사람은 가장 큰 마이너스다. 그보다 더 뺄셈은 없다”며 “대표한테 당신 물러나라고 하는 게 뺄셈 정치”라고 했다. 이어 “명백한 해당행위는 전쟁에서 우리 편을 향해서 총을 쏘는 것, 그리고 적을 돕는 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr ( 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] Presidential Office "Leverage ETFs, will supplement if necessary... under discussion at F4" ([속보] 청와대 “레버리지 ETF, 필요하면 보완…F4에서 고민 중”)
item.description:
The presidential office stated on the 10th that relevant authorities are reviewing the situation regarding concerns over the volatility of leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. (청와대가 10일 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) 변동성 우려에 대해 관련 부처가 상황을 점검하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the presidential office's policy division, said during a briefing at the Cheong Wa Dae Chunchugwan, "The market situation review meeting, involving the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Financial Services Commission, the Bank of Korea, and the Financial Supervisory Service—known as the F4—is examining the market conditions and deliberating on the matter." The F4 meeting is a consultative body where Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yun-cheol, Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won, and Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin gather to discuss macroeconomic and financial market issues. (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 이날 청와대 춘추관 브리핑에서 “재정경제부, 금융위, 한국은행, 금융감독원이 참여하는 시장상황점검회의, 소위 에프(F)4라고 하는 데서 시장 상황을 살펴보고, 고민 중에 있다”고 말했다. 에프(F)4 회의는 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관, 신현송 한국은행 총재, 이억원 금융위원장, 이찬진 금융감독원장이 모여 거시경제와 금융시장 현안 등을 논의하는 협의체다.)

Director Kim stated, "Since it has been about a month and a half since the leveraged ETFs were introduced, the F4 plans to closely examine their impact on the market. If any adjustments are needed, I believe the F4 will make a decision." (김 실장은 “(레버리지 상장지수펀드가) 도입된 지 한 달 반 정도 지났기 때문에 시장에 어떤 영향이 있는지 에프(F)4에서 면밀히 살펴볼 예정”이라며 “보완이 필요하다면 에프(F)4에서 결정 내려주지 않을까 생각한다”고 말했다.)

The leveraged ETFs for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have sparked controversy due to their high volatility, which has led to issues such as losses for individual investors. (삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)는 변동성이 커 개인투자자 손실 등 여러 부작용이 드러나 논란이 되고 있다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji: yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party's Hong Ki-won: "Partial Retention of Supplementary Investigation Rights Needed… Plans to Propose Separate Criminal Procedure Act Amendment" (민주 홍기원 “보완수사권 일부 존치 필요…형소법 별도 발의 추진”)
item.description:
Hong Ki-won, a member of the Democratic Party of Korea who has raised concerns about the complete abolition of supplementary investigation rights, stated on the 10th that regarding the Criminal Procedure Act amendment prepared by the Democratic Party's Criminal Procedure Act Amendment Task Force (TF), "it fundamentally cannot resolve the problems arising from the abolition of supplementary investigation rights." He is preparing to propose a separate Criminal Procedure Act amendment centered on the exceptional retention of supplementary investigation rights. (보완수사권 완전 폐지에 우려를 제기해온 홍기원 더불어민주당 의원이 민주당 형사소송법 개정 티에프(TF)가 마련한 형사소송법 개정안에 대해 “보완수사권 폐지에 따른 문제를 근본적으로 해소할 수 없다”며 보완수사권 예외적 존치 등을 뼈대로 한 별도의 형사소송법 개정안 발의를 준비하고 있다고 10일 밝혔다.)

Appearing on KBS Radio's "Emergency Current Affairs" that day, Representative Hong commented on the Criminal Procedure Act amendment proposed by the Democratic Party's Criminal Procedure Act Amendment TF the previous day, saying, "Without supplementary investigation rights, it seems many safety devices have been put in place, but it cannot essentially resolve the issues that arise when supplementary investigation rights are abolished. There are cases where supplementary investigation rights must be partially retained." (홍 의원은 이날 한국방송(KBS) 라디오 ‘전격시사’에 출연해 전날 민주당 형사소송법 개정 티에프가 발의한 형사소송법 개정안과 관련해 “보완수사권이 없을 경우에 여러 안전장치를 많이 마련한 것 같긴 한데, 보완수사권을 폐지했을 때 생기는 문제들을 본질적으로 해소할 수는 없다”며 “보완수사권을 일부 존치해야만 하는 그런 사안들이 있다”고 밝혔다.)

Representative Hong continued, "Until now, I have only argued that 'deliberation is needed' and 'we must discuss whether there are any problems with completely abolishing supplementary investigation rights.' However, only bills abolishing supplementary investigation rights have been proposed, and discussions are progressing rapidly. I thought that if I wanted to continue making this argument, I needed to present an alternative," revealing his plan to separately prepare and propose a Criminal Procedure Act amendment. (이어 홍 의원은 “그동안 저는 ‘숙의가 필요하다', ‘보완수사권을 완전히 폐지하는 데 따른 문제가 없는지 논의해야 한다'는 주장만 했는데, 이미 보완수사권을 폐지하는 법안들만 발의돼 논의가 빠르게 진전되고 있다”며 “제가 이 주장을 계속하려면 대안을 내야겠다고 생각했다”며 형사소송법 개정안을 따로 마련해 발의하겠다는 계획을 밝혔다.)

Representative Hong stated, "There are concerns that prosecutors might misuse this again, conducting unrelated investigations, which is why many people believe supplementary investigation rights should not exist. So I am structuring the bill to eliminate such concerns." (홍 의원은 “검사들이 다시 또 이걸 가지고 장난치는 거 아니냐, 별건 수사하는 거 아니냐는 우려가 있어서 보완수사권을 두면 안 된다고 많은 국민이 생각하는 것 아닌가. 그래서 그런 우려가 없도록 법안을 구성하고 있다”고 했다.)

The Criminal Procedure Act amendment that Representative Hong is preparing stipulates that supplementary investigation requests should be the principle, but exceptions to supplementary investigation rights are allowed for crimes targeting socially vulnerable groups, such as sex crimes, crimes against children, people with disabilities, and the elderly, as well as livelihood cases, cases where the statute of limitations is imminent, and cases occurring simultaneously in multiple regions requiring consolidated investigations. To eliminate concerns about unrelated or arbitrary investigations, compulsory investigations would require approval from the local chief prosecutor, and a case review committee would be established to deliberate on the appropriateness of the prosecution's supplementary investigations. (홍 의원이 준비하는 형사소송법 개정안은 보완수사 요구를 원칙으로 하되 성범죄, 아동·장애인·노인 대상 범죄 등 사회적 약자를 대상으로 하는 범죄나 민생 사건, 공소시효가 임박한 사건, 여러 지역에서 동시다발적으로 벌어져 병합 수사가 필요한 사건 등에 대해서는 보완수사권의 예외를 인정하도록 했다. 별건 수사나 임의 수사의 우려를 없애기 위해 강제수사는 지방 공소청장의 승인 하도록 하고, 사건심의위원회에서 검찰의 보완수사가 적절한지 심의를 하도록 하는 장치를 마련했다.)

Representative Hong said, "A draft was produced today. To submit it as a bill after legislative review by the National Assembly, it needs the consent of 10 lawmakers, so we need to start working on that from now." He added, "Once that work is completed, I plan to propose it as quickly as possible. I think the leadership and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee will also review whether partially retaining supplementary investigation rights is a better approach." (홍 의원은 “오늘 초안이 나왔다”며 “(국회) 법제실 심의를 거쳐서 법안으로 발의하려면 의원 10명의 동의가 있어야 하기 때문에 이제부터 그 작업을 해야 한다”고 했다. 이어 “(그 작업이 완료되면) 최대한 빠른 시간 내에 발의할 생각이다. 지도부에서도 또 법사위에서도 보완수사권 일부를 존치하는 게 더 좋은 방법인지 아닌지에 대해서 같이 검토하게 될 것으로 생각한다”고 했다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok: "How Did Han Dong-hoon Handle His Own Controversies?" ... Emotional Clash Over 'Jung Yi-han's Staged Incident' (이준석 “한동훈, 본인 의혹은 어찌 처신했나”…‘정이한 자작극’ 감정싸움)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, stated on Thursday that the party was completely unaware of reports that former Busan mayoral candidate Jung Yi-han had already admitted to staging an attack during police questioning before the June 3 local elections. He also took a sharp jab at independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who has targeted the Reform Party over the controversy, saying, "Every citizen knows how he handled his own controversies (the party board dispute)." <<> Lee told reporters at the National Assembly on Thursday morning, "Some politicians can raise suspicions, but it's highly unlikely that such a person would have told us (that he was a suspect), and the police have said they didn't officially notify us either. We couldn't have known, and we didn't know." <<> Jung Yi-han, the former Reform Party candidate for Busan mayor, collapsed on April 27 near the Guseo Junction in Geumjeong-gu, Busan, while campaigning, after trying to avoid a drink thrown by a driver identified as Mr. A. It later emerged that the incident was staged, leading to his arrest on the 8th on charges of obstruction of official duties through deception and violations of the Public Official Election Act. Jung was found to have continued his campaign even after confessing to the crime during police questioning in mid-May. <<> When asked if he noticed anything suspicious around mid-May, when Jung was reported to have admitted to the staged attack, Lee said, "He was one of eight metropolitan government heads, and I wasn't particularly focused on supporting or paying attention to that area, so I wasn't individually aware of it." <<> Regarding the ongoing internal investigation by the party, Lee said, "Since Jung has left the party, we have no compulsory authority, so it's limited. Even the Busan campaign staff said they didn't know what was happening until the day of the raid and seizure. We asked them, but we can't get answers." Lee added, "I could routinely say we'll strengthen candidate vetting, but this case doesn't seem like a clear example. With triple-digit candidates nominated, unusual cases occurred among them. We can't promise preventive measures, but we will tighten post-nomination management to ensure such things don't happen again." <<> Targeting lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who earlier said, "The Reform Party must reveal when they knew it was a staged incident," Lee said, "There must be another reason why Han keeps bringing this up. Every citizen knows how Han handled his own controversial incident, but the Reform Party didn't add anything to it." He added, "I know what his original profession (prosecutor) is, but I hope he doesn't look at things with such a twisted perspective." <<> Earlier, Han posted on Facebook, saying, "Candidate Jung gained more votes through sympathy from the staged attack than he would have otherwise. Busan citizens were deceived into voting, and their right to vote was stolen. If it had been known before the election that the attack was staged, far fewer Busan citizens would have voted for Jung, and the (Busan mayoral) election result might have changed." He continued, "The police and the Reform Party must reveal when they knew it was a staged incident, and if they knew before the election, they must take responsibility for infringing on the political rights of Busan citizens." <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (이준석 개혁신당 대표가 정이한 전 부산시장 후보가 6·3 지방선거 전 이미 경찰 조사에서 피습 자작극을 인정했다는 보도와 관련해 “(당은) 전혀 몰랐다”고 했다. 그러면서 해당 의혹과 관련 개혁신당을 겨냥한 한동훈 무소속 의원에 대해 “본인 관련 의혹(당원게시판 논란)에 대해 어떻게 처신했는지 모든 국민이 알고 있다”고 날을 세웠다.)

item.title: Korea-U.S. consultations begin on relocation of Gwangju Air Base… U.S. military: "Gwangju base holds significant military interests" (‘광주 군공항 이전’ 한미 협의 시작…미군 “광주기지 중요한 군사적 이해”)
item.description:
The government has confirmed the site of the Gwangju Air Base, a Korea-U.S. Air Force Combined Operations Base (COB), as the location for a southwestern semiconductor industrial cluster, initiating consultations between the defense and diplomatic authorities of South Korea and the United States on the matter. (정부가 한미 공군 공동운영기지(COB)인 광주 군공항 부지를 서남권 반도체 산업단지 입지로 확정하면서, 이를 위한 한미 국방·외교 당국의 협의를 시작했다.)

On the 10th, Kim Yong-beom, head of the Cheong Wa Dae policy office, stated at a press briefing at Cheong Wa Dae's Chunchugwan that regarding the relocation of Gwangju Air Base, "This is an issue that obviously requires consultation between South Korea and the U.S., and consultations have already begun." The Ministry of National Defense also announced on the same day, "While striving to ensure no issues with readiness, we plan to closely coordinate with the Air Force and the U.S. side to meet national policy objectives." (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 10일 청와대 춘추관 브리핑에서 광주 군공항 이전 등과 관련해 “당연히 한미가 협의를 해야할 (사안)이고, 이미 협의를 시작했다”고 말했다. 국방부도 이날 “대비태세에 문제가 없도록 노력하는 동시에 국가정책에 부응하기 위해 공군 및 미국 쪽과 긴밀히 협의할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

Gwangju Air Base, one of five air bases operated jointly by the South Korean and U.S. Air Forces, is a site where U.S. air power would be deployed in times of war or emergencies, though U.S. operational units do not normally station there in peacetime. Instead, during the annual combined air exercise "Freedom Flag," led by the South Korean military, the U.S. Air Force conducts training at Gwangju Air Base once a year. Additionally, a small number of U.S. troops are stationed at Gwangju Air Base, along with minor facilities for U.S. Air Force logistical support. It is also known that there are U.S. military sites provided under the Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA), necessitating bilateral consultations for the relocation of the air base. <<> On the same day, Major Laura Hayden, spokesperson for the U.S. Seventh Air Force in South Korea, stated, "The U.S. Seventh Air Force has significant military interests in Gwangju Air Base and will continue close coordination with the Republic of Korea Air Force to meet all requirements and maintain a robust combined readiness posture." Major Hayden added, "Through close cooperation with the Republic of Korea Air Force, we maintain a firm vigilance posture and are fully prepared to fight tonight." <<> Furthermore, the U.S. Forces Korea (USFK) declined to comment on policy-related matters where the host nation (South Korea) has not yet made a final decision but stated, "USFK remains committed to maintaining ready-to-fight capabilities on the Korean Peninsula and a strong combined defense posture with our ally, South Korea." <<> However, the Ministry of National Defense refrained from disclosing the specifics of the consultations, stating, "No concrete plans have been decided yet." With the government emphasizing a "speed-driven approach" to the semiconductor industrial cluster site, the swift relocation of military units and the dispersion of training requirements have become pressing tasks. Additionally, there is a growing need to expedite consultations with the United States. <<> There are other cases of relocating air bases that serve as combined operations bases. Daegu City decided to relocate Daegu Air Base to Gunwi and Uiseong counties in North Gyeongsang Province, aiming for a move by 2030. For this, South Korea and the U.S. have been conducting consultations based on the Status of Forces Agreement. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (한미 공군의 공동운영기지인 5개 군공항 중 한 곳인 광주 군공항은 전시 등 유사시 미 항공전력이 전개되는 곳으로, 미 공군 작전부대가 평시에 주둔하진 않는다. 대신 한국군 주도로 한미 연합공중훈련인 ‘프리덤 플래그’를 실시할 때 미 공군은 연 1회 광주 군공항에서 훈련을 한다. 또한 광주 공항엔 미 공군 군수지원을 위한 소규모 시설과 함께 소수 미군이 상주하고 있다. 또 주한미군지위협정(SOFA)에 따라 공여된 미군 부지가 있는 것으로 알려져, 공항 이전과 관련해서도 한미 협의가 필요하다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Lawmaker Im O-kyung Withdraws Request for Son Heung-min and Hwang Hee-chan as Hearing Witnesses ([단독] 임오경 의원, 손흥민·황희찬 청문회 참고인 신청 철회)
item.description:
Im O-kyung, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, had applied for national football team players Son Heung-min and Hwang Hee-chan to be called as witnesses for an upcoming hearing by the National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee regarding issues concerning the Korea Football Association, scheduled for the 22nd, but has since withdrawn the request. (임오경 더불어민주당 의원이 오는 22일 열릴 예정인 국회 문화체육관광위원회 대한축구협회 현안 관련 청문회에 국가대표 축구선수 손흥민과 황희찬을 참고인으로 신청했다가 철회했다.)

On the 10th, Representative Im posted on Facebook stating, "I believed the hearing should not be one-sided, hearing only one side. I applied for witnesses to hear the voices of active players who have the closest experience with the association, the national team, and the overseas football system." She added, "However, after comprehensively considering the party's opinions, the players' match schedules, and their positions, I withdrew the witness application." Representative Im further noted, "This decision was not meant to place burden on the players, but to create a better hearing for the development of Korean football." (임 의원은 10일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “한쪽의 이야기만 듣는 반쪽짜리 청문회가 되어서는 안 된다고 생각했다. 협회와 국가대표팀, 해외 축구 시스템을 가장 가까이에서 경험한 현역 선수들의 목소리를 듣고자 참고인을 신청했다”며 “하지만 당의 의견과 선수들의 경기 일정, 입장을 종합적으로 고려해 참고인 신청을 철회했다”고 밝혔다. 임 의원은 “이는 선수들에게 부담을 주기 위한 것이 아니라, 한국 축구의 발전을 위한 더 나은 청문회를 만들기 위한 결정”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, on the 9th, the Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee held a plenary session, where the implementation plan for the hearing on issues related to the Korea Football Association was adopted under the leadership of the Democratic Party. Witnesses for the hearing, scheduled for 10 a.m. on the 22nd, include former national football team head coach Hong Myung-bo, former Korea Football Association President Chung Mong-gyu, and former KFA Technical Director Lee Im-saeng, who played a leading role in the appointment of former head coach Hong. Witnesses included Park Ji-sung, co-chair of the K-Football Innovation Committee; Yoo Seung-min, co-chair of the K-Football Innovation Committee; Lee Young-pyo and Park Joo-ho, members of the K-Football Innovation Committee; as well as Son Heung-min and Hwang Hee-chan. Among the members of the Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee, Representative Im was the only one to request Son Heung-min and Hwang Hee-chan as witnesses. (앞서 문체위는 9일 전체회의를 열어 대한축구협회 현안 관련 청문회 실시계획서를 민주당 주도로 채택했다. 22일 오전 10시 열리는 청문회 증인에는 홍명보 전 축구 국가대표팀 감독, 정몽규 전 대한축구협회장, 홍 전 감독 선임 당시 주도적 역할을 했던 이임생 전 축구협회 기술총괄이사 등이 포함됐다. 참고인에는 박지성 케이(K)-축구 혁신위원회 공동위원장과 유승민 케이-축구 혁신위 공동위원장, 이영표·박주호 케이-축구 혁신위원과 더불어 손흥민, 황희찬 등이 이름을 올렸다. 손흥민과 황희찬을 참고인으로 신청한 의원은 문체위 위원 가운데 임 의원이 유일했다.)

This drew criticism, with questions like "Why call Son Heung-min and Hwang Hee-chan?" Football commentator Park Moon-sung said on the YouTube channel 'Dalsunelive' on the 9th, "First of all, those two players basically cannot attend. They probably didn't even check in advance whether they could attend," and added, "Even if we give in 100 times, if they came, what would you want to ask? Are you trying to ask how they felt about not being selected for the starting lineup? (The witness request) is not reasonable." (이를 두고 “손흥민과 황희찬을 왜 부르냐”는 비판의 목소리가 나왔다. 박문성 축구 해설위원은 9일 유튜브 채널 ‘달수네라이브’에서 “(두 선수는) 일단 기본적으로 나올 수가 없다. 사전에 (출석 가능한지 여부를) 물어보지도 않았을 것”이라며 “백번 양보해서 나오면 뭘 물어보고 싶나. 선발 안 뛰었는데 기분이 어땠나 이걸 물어보고 싶은 건가. (참고인 신청은) 상식적이지 않다”고 비판했다.)

Reporter Lee Yu-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'Party Favorability' Democratic Party 44%, People Power Party 22%…Centrists 42% vs 16% (‘정당 호감도’ 민주 44%, 국힘 22%…중도층은 42% 대 16%)
item.description:
A poll released on the 10th shows that the favorability rating of the Democratic Party of Korea has dropped by 6 percentage points to 44% since the June 3 local elections. The People Power Party's unfavorability rating fell by 1 percentage point to 69%. (6·3 지방선거 이후 더불어민주당 호감도가 6%포인트 하락한 44%를 기록했다는 여론조사 결과가 10일 나왔다. 국민의힘은 비호감도가 1%포인트 하락한 69%를 기록했다.)

Gallup Korea surveyed 1,002 people nationwide from the 7th to the 9th on their favorability toward the five major political parties in the National Assembly (with a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, via telephone interviews). The results showed that 44% of respondents said they had a "favorable" impression of the Democratic Party, while 45% said they had an "unfavorable" impression. Compared to the previous survey in March (favorability 50%, unfavorability 39%), favorability dropped by 6 percentage points, and unfavorability rose by 6 percentage points. Gallup has been regularly surveying favorability toward major political parties since 2018. ( 한국갤럽이 지난 7∼9일 전국 1002명을 대상으로 원내 5개 정당별 호감 여부를 조사(표본오차 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%포인트, 전화면접조사)한 결과 민주당에 ‘호감이 간다’고 답한 비율은 44%였다. ‘호감이 가지 않는다’는 비율은 45%였다. 직전 조사인 지난 3월(호감도 50%, 비호감도 39%)대비 호감도는 6%포인트 떨어지고, 비호감도는 6%포인트 올랐다. 갤럽은 2018년부터 정기적으로 주요 정당별 호감 여부를 조사해왔다.)

The decline in the Democratic Party's favorability was particularly pronounced among centrists and those in their 30s and 40s. Among centrists, the Democratic Party's favorability fell from 56% to 42%, while unfavorability stood at 46%. By age group, favorability dropped from 44% to 31% among those in their 30s and from 61% to 48% among those in their 40s. ( 중도층과 30·40대에서 민주당 호감도 하락폭이 컸다. 중도층의 민주당 호감도는 56%에서 42%로 줄었다. 비호감도는 46%를 기록했다. 연령별로 호감도에서는 30대가 44%에서 31%로, 40대가 61%에서 48%로 하락했다. )

The public's favorability toward the People Power Party was 22%. That is up 3 percentage points from the previous survey (19%), but still half that of the Democratic Party. Among centrists, favorability was 16%. Unfavorability fell by 1 percentage point to 69%. The People Power Party's favorability peaked at a record high of 41% in April 2022, shortly after the 20th presidential election, then steadily declined, remaining in the 20% range after former President Yoon Suk Yeol's declaration of martial law. ( 국민의힘에 대한 국민 호감도는 22%로 나타났다. 지난 조사(19%) 대비 3%포인트 올랐지만, 민주당의 절반 수준이다. 중도층에서 호감도 16%였다. 비호감도는 1%포인트 떨어진 69%였다. 국민의힘 호감도는 20대 대선 직후인 2022년 4월 역대 최고치인 41%를 기록한 뒤로 하락을 거듭해, 윤석열 전 대통령 비상계엄 이후에는 20%대에 머물고 있다.)

The People Power Party's unfavorability reached 74% among centrists. It was also high at 51% among conservatives. Even among the People Power Party's own supporters, favorability was 64% and unfavorability was 30%. Gallup Korea analyzed that "85% of Democratic Party supporters and 64% of People Power Party supporters said they have a favorable view of the party they currently support, indicating a difference in cohesion." ( 국민의힘의 비호감도는 중도층에서 74%에 달했다. 보수층에서도 51%로 높았다. 국민의힘 지지자로 좁혀서 봐도 호감도가 64%, 비호감도가 30%를 기록했다. 한국갤럽은 “더불어민주당 지지층의 85%, 국민의힘 지지층의 64%가 현재 지지하는 정당에 호감이 간다고 답해 응집력에도 차이가 있다”고 분석했다.)

The Rebuilding Korea Party recorded a favorability rating of 20% and an unfavorability rating of 66%. The Progressive Party had a favorability of 19% and an unfavorability of 62%. The Reform Party's favorability was 10%, with unfavorability at 73%. ( 조국혁신당에 대한 호감도는 20%, 비호감도는 66%를 기록했다. 진보당 호감도는 19%, 비호감도는 62%였다. 개혁신당은 호감도 10%, 비호감도 73%다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr ( 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae's camp opposes 'preferential voting system'... Democratic Supreme Council to discuss until tonight (정청래 쪽 반발한 ‘선호투표제’…민주 최고위 오늘 밤까지 논의)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea held a heated debate among its Supreme Council members on the 10th over the preferential voting system, which was set to be introduced for the August 17th party convention's leadership election. After failing to reach a conclusion during the morning Supreme Council meeting, the Democratic Party decided to reconvene tonight to finalize the discussion. <<> Senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun told reporters after the morning Supreme Council meeting, "We did not reach a conclusion regarding the method for the party leadership and Supreme Council member election primaries, as well as the method for the elected youth Supreme Council member primary." He added, "Acting leader and floor leader Han Byung-do stated that a conclusion would be reached today in some form. Although the time has not been set, we will hold another Supreme Council meeting tonight to make a decision." <<> The preferential voting system is a method where, if no candidate receives a majority in a race with three or more candidates, the lowest-ranked candidate is eliminated, and their second-choice votes are added to the top two candidates to determine the final winner on the same day. The party's election management committee previously decided to hold the party leadership election using the preferential voting system, but Jeong's camp objected, claiming it violated the party's constitution and rules. This led to a re-discussion the previous day, where the committee reaffirmed its position, stating it was "difficult to view it as a violation of the party constitution and rules." Ultimately, the Supreme Council must decide whether to finalize the preferential voting system. <<> This dispute revolves around Article 25 of the Democratic Party's constitution, which states that "the party leader is elected by a majority vote, and specific matters such as holding a runoff for this purpose shall be determined by party rules," and Article 66 of the party rules. Jeong's camp argues that the preferential voting system is not a runoff. <<> During the Supreme Council meeting, Supreme Council members close to former leader Jeong Cheong-rae and former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok engaged in a public debate over the preferential voting system. <<> Supreme Council member Hwang Myeong-seon, who has been at odds with former leader Jeong, criticized, "The preferential voting system is our party's runoff method, introduced under leader Lee Jae-myung through legitimate interpretations of the party constitution and rules and decision-making processes, and it is a legacy left by President Lee to the party." He added, "Dragging out the decision now because it's disadvantageous to a specific candidate, or trying to overturn the party's decision based on interests, marks the beginning of factionalization." Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu, close to former Prime Minister Kim, said, "In this phase of rule setting ahead of candidate registration, there's no explanation for why a norm that has been fine for a year suddenly becomes a rule violation unless it's about calculating advantages." <<> In response, Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok, close to former leader Jeong, argued, "The party rules clearly distinguish between preferential voting and runoff as different voting methods, and stipulate runoffs as the method for determining the winner of the party leadership election." She added, "Revising the rules with only a week left will invite further controversy." Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon also said, "Before discussing advantages, applying the preferential voting system, which clearly violates the party constitution and rules, would require amending the party constitution and rules, just as President Lee did." <<> Reporter Ko Han-sol: sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hye-min: jhm@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에서 도입하기로 한 선호투표제를 두고 최고위원들이 10일 최고위원회의에서 공방을 벌였다. 이날 오전 최고위원회의 논의에서도 결론을 내지 못한 민주당은 이날 밤 다시 최고위원회의를 열어 논의를 마무리 짓기로 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Visits Memorial Hall of 'Lee Tae-jun' in Mongolia, Visits Site of His Presumed Martyrdom (이 대통령, 몽골서 ‘이태준 선생’ 기념관 참배…순국 추정지 방문)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Mongolia, visited the Lee Tae-jun Memorial Hall on the 10th (local time) and paid respects at the grave of Lee Tae-jun. (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 10일(현지시각) 이태준 기념관을 방문해 이태준 선생 묘소를 참배했다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jeong announced in a written briefing that this marks the first visit by a South Korean president to the Lee Tae-jun Memorial Hall in Mongolia since former President Lee Myung-bak's visit in August 2011, 15 years ago. The Lee Tae-jun Memorial Hall was established to widely publicize the contributions of independence activist Lee Tae-jun, who dedicated himself to Korea's independence movement and the modernization of Mongolia's medical field. (대한민국 대통령이 몽골 이태준 기념관을 방문한 것은 2011년 8월 이명박 전 대통령 방문 이후 15년 만이라고 강유정 수석대변인이 서면브리핑을 통해 밝혔다. 이태준 기념관은 독립유공자 이태준 선생이 조국의 독립운동과 몽골 근대 의료 발전에 기여한 업적을 널리 알리기 위해 조성된 공간이다.)

President Lee laid a floral tribute at the symbolic grave of Lee Tae-jun and paid his respects before moving to the memorial hall. President Lee personally asked, "Was Lee Tae-jun a disciple of Ahn Chang-ho?" and the interpreter responded, "He regarded him as a mentor." (이 대통령은 이태준 선생의 가묘에 화롱을 헌화하고 참배한 뒤 기념관으로 이동했다. 이 대통령은 이태준 선생이 “안창호 선생의 제자였냐”고 직접 물었고, 해설사는 “멘토로 삼았다”고 답하기도 했다.)

Subsequently, President Lee spent considerable time examining an independence newspaper that reported Lee Tae-jun's contribution of 10 won to the provisional government for independence funding, asking, "Is it permissible to publicly disclose in a newspaper that someone provided independence funds?" He also showed interest in the reason the contributor's name was listed as 'Lee Dae-am,' remarking, "It seems a pseudonym was used to prevent identity exposure." (이어 이 대통령은 이태준 선생이 임시정부에 독립운동 자금으로 10원을 지원한 사실을 알린 독립신문을 한동안 유심히 살펴보며 “독립자금을 낸 사실을 신문에 공개해도 되는 것이냐”라고 묻기도 했다. 그러면서 자금 지원자의 이름이 ‘이대암’으로 기재된 이유에 대해 “신분 노출을 막기 위해 가명을 사용한 모양이군요”라며 관심을 보였다.)

As it was explained that Lee Tae-jun's remains have not yet been recovered, leading to the creation of a symbolic grave, and that according to Lyuh Woon-hyung's "Travels in the Mongolian Desert," the area near the Zaisan Memorial is believed to be where his body was recovered and buried shortly after his martyrdom, President Lee proposed an immediate visit to the Zaisan Memorial. The Zaisan hill, where the Zaisan Memorial and Victory Monument are located, is presumed to be the burial site of Lee Tae-jun, who died a martyr in 1921, and is a popular landmark in Ulaanbaatar frequented by Mongolian citizens and foreign tourists. (이 대통령은 아직까지 이태준 선생의 유해를 찾지 못해 가묘가 조성돼 있으며 여운형의 ‘몽고사막여행기’에 따라 자이승 전망대 인근이 순국 직후 시신을 수습해 안장했던 곳으로 추정된다는 설명을 듣고 즉석에서 자이승 전망대 이동을 제안했다. 자이승 전망대와 전승기념탑이 위치한 자이승 산기슭은 1921년 순국한 이태준 선생이 안장된 곳으로 추정되는 장소로 몽골 국민과 외국인 관광객들이 즐겨 찾는 울란바타르의 대표적 명소로 꼽힌다.)

Climbing the 400 steps to the Zaisan Memorial, President Lee looked out over Ulaanbaatar and inquired about the stark differences between areas with and without forests, as well as developed and undeveloped regions. Senior Press Secretary Kang reported that the Mongolian ambassador to South Korea and the South Korean ambassador to Mongolia explained that many people still live in traditional gers at the base of the hill. President Lee also asked about the progress of Mongolia's second capital city plan and expressed interest in the explanation that Sejong City was being used as a model. (400개의 계단을 올라 자이승 전망대에 오른 이 대통령은 울란바타르 시내를 둘러보며 산림이 조성된 지역과 그렇지 않은 지역, 개발된 지역과 그렇지 않은 지역의 차이가 많이 나는지를 묻기도 했다. 이에 주한몽골대사와 주몽골대한민국대사가 아직 산 밑에는 게르를 짓고 전통방식으로 살아가는 국민들이 많다고 설명했다고 강 수석대변인은 전했다. 이 대통령은 몽골의 제2수도 건설 계획의 추진 현황을 물어보며 세종시를 모델로 추진한다는 설명에 관심을 나타냈다.)

President Lee also took commemorative photos with South Koreans he encountered by chance. item.title: [Breaking] President Lee Appoints Vice Minister Im Gi-geun of Planning and Budget Office as Head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination ([속보] 이 대통령, 국무조정실장에 임기근 기획처 차관 임명)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung appointed Vice Minister of Planning and Budget Im Gi-geun as the new Head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination on the 10th. (이재명 대통령이 10일 신임 국무조정실장에 임기근 기획예산처 차관을 임명했다.)

Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations and Communications Sung Ki-hong announced this at a presidential office briefing on the same day. (성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 이같이 발표했다.)

Secretary Sung stated, “With his experience in coordinating complex economic policies, we expect him, as the new Head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, to rationally coordinate interests between ministries and stably manage national agenda issues,” adding, “He is the right person to assist the Prime Minister, supporting the leap to a super-gap industrial powerhouse and growth for all citizens, underpinning an irreplaceable Republic of Korea.” (성 수석은 “복잡한 경제정책을 조정해온 경험으로 신임 국무조정실장으로 부처간 이해를 합리적으로 조정하고 국정현안을 안정적으로 관리할 것으로 기대한다”며 “국무총리를 보좌하며 초격차 산업강국 도약과 국민 모두의 성장 등 대체불가 대한민국을 뒷받침할 적임자”라고 말했다.)

Vice Minister Im began his public service career after passing the 36th Higher Civil Service Examination in 1992. He subsequently served as Director of the Policy Coordination Bureau and Director General for Budget Comprehensive Review at the Ministry of Planning and Budget, and later served as the Commissioner of the Public Procurement Service. (임 차관은 1992년 행정고시(36회)로 공직에 입문한 이후 기획재정부에서 정책조정국장, 예산총괄심의관 등을 거쳤다. 이후 조달청장도 지냈다.)

The Head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, a ministerial-level position, assists the Prime Minister and oversees the overall state affairs. (장관급인 국무조정실장은 국무총리를 보좌해 국정 전반을 총괄한다.)

item.title: Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek Dismisses Desertion Allegations as “False… Will Correct Record Error After Retirement” (안규백 국방장관, 탈영 의혹에 “허위…퇴임 뒤 기록 오류 정정할 것”)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense stated that the allegations of desertion during Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek’s service as a short-term soldier (defense soldier) are “clearly false,” and that Minister Ahn will file a request to correct the error in his military records once he completes his term. (국방부가 안규백 국방부 장관의 단기사병(방위병) 시절 군무이탈(탈영) 의혹과 관련해 “탈영 (주장)은 명백한 허위”라며 안 장관이 임기를 마치면 병적기록 오류에 대한 정정 청구를 할 것이라고 밝혔다.)

A defense ministry official told reporters on the 10th, “The same allegations were raised a year ago (during the personnel hearing),” adding, “Since filing a correction request as the defense minister could spark further controversy over how it would be perceived, we plan to take additional measures once he returns to a status without any power after fulfilling his assigned duties.” (국방부 관계자는 10일 기자들과 만나 “1년 전 (인사청문회) 에도 똑같은 의혹이 제기됐다”며 “국방장관 신분으로 정정 청구를 하면 이를 어떻게 볼지 또 다른 논란이 나올 수 있어 부여된 임무를 마치고 아무런 권력이 없는 신분으로 돌아갔을 때 추가 조치를 할 것”이라고 말했다.)

The conservative opposition has claimed that the minister’s military record shows a service period of 22 months, not 14 months, and has recently revived the allegation, first raised during his parliamentary confirmation hearing in July of last year, that he deserted for an additional seven months of service. However, the official cited the existence of Minister Ahn’s transcript for the first semester of 1985 as evidence, stating, “It is clear that Minister Ahn enlisted on November 5, 1983, and was discharged on January 4, 1985.” The implication is that since Minister Ahn was processed for discharge after 14 months, he returned to school, completed the first semester, and received the transcript. (보수 야권은 장관의 병적기록부에 복무기간이 14개월이 아닌 22개월로 기록됐다고 주장하며, 그가 탈영을 해 7개월 추가 복무를 했다는 의혹을 지난해 7월 장관 인사청문회에 이어 최근 다시 제기하고 있다. 그러나 이 관계자는 안 장관의 1985년 1학기 성적표가 존재하는 것을 근거로 들며 “(안 장관은) 1983년 11월 5일 입대해 1985년 1월 4일 제대 사실이 분명하다”고도 했다. 안 장관이 14개월 이후 전역 처리가 됐기에 이후 복학해 1학기를 마치고 성적표를 받았다는 취지다.)

Minister Ahn’s stance is that during his service, his mother provided free lunches to active-duty soldiers for two to three weeks, leading to a three-day military investigation, and that this period was not counted toward his service days. Upon returning to university, he was notified to serve additional duty and fulfilled this during the summer vacation of August 1985, which then became his discharge date. The defense ministry stated that Minister Ahn served a few extra days beyond the investigation period (three days), and a defense ministry official noted that Minister Ahn himself “did not know” why the additional service period was longer, adding, “(Thus) he describes himself as a victim of an administrative error.” (안 장관은 복무 중 모친이 2∼3주 동안 현역병에게 점심을 무료로 제공했다는 이유로 군에서 3일간 조사를 받았는데, 이 조사 기간이 복무 일수에 포함되지 않았다는 입장이다. 이에 대학에 복학한 뒤 추가 복무를 하라는 통보를 받고 1985년 8월 방학 기간 이를 이행했는데, 이 시점이 전역일로 잡혔다는 주장이다. 국방부는 당시 안 장관이 조사 기간(3일)을 넘겨 며칠 더 추가 복무를 했다고 밝혔는데, 국방부 관계자는 안 장관도 추가 복무 기간이 더 길었던 이유를 “몰랐다”며 “(그래서) 자신을 행정착오의 피해자라고 말하는 것”이라고 했다.)

Another defense ministry official said, “Minister Ahn admitted at the hearing that he was investigated for a few days, but he received no punishment, including detention,” adding, “That’s why he claims to be a victim of a military record administrative error.” The official also noted that during Minister Ahn’s service as a short-term soldier, his home was a two-minute walk from the unit, asking, “How could a short-term soldier who commuted to and from work desert for seven months?” (다른 국방부 관계자도 “안 장관이 며칠간 조사를 받은 사실이 있다고 (청문회에서) 말했지만, 구금을 비롯해 어떤 처분도 받은 사실이 없다”며 “그래서 본인이 병적 행정오류의 피해자라고 주장한 것”이라고 했다. 또 안 장관이 단기사병으로 복무할 때 부대에서 자택까지 도보 2분 거리였다며 “출퇴근하는 단기 사병이 어떻게 7개월 동안 탈영을 하겠느냐”고도 반문했다.)

However, Minister Ahn maintains his stance of not disclosing his military records, as demanded by the conservative opposition. A defense ministry official explained, “If we release a record from 40 years ago with errors, wouldn’t only the erroneous record remain in people’s memories, regardless of the facts?” adding, “It would only fuel further misunderstanding.” (다만 안 장관은 보수 야권이 요구하는 병적기록 공개는 하지 않겠다는 입장이다. 국방부 관계자는 “40년 전 잘못된 기록을 공개하면 사실관계와 상관없이 잘못된 기록만이 기억 속에 남지 않겠나”라며 “오해만 더 키울 것”이라고 설명했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Launches 'Mega Project Special Committee'… "Public Debate on 52-Hour Exemption for Professionals Also On the Table" (민주 ‘메가 프로젝트 특위’ 출범…“전문직 52시간 예외도 공론화”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea held the first meeting of its 'Three Major Mega Projects Special Committee,' stating that it will "boldly rationalize regulations." The party also announced it would include the so-called 'White-Collar Exemption,' which allows an exception to the 52-hour weekly work cap for high-income professionals, in its discussion topics. (더불어민주당이 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트 특별위원회’ 첫 번째 회의를 열고 “규제를 과감하게 합리화해나가겠다”고 밝혔다. 민주당은 고소득 전문직 노동자에 대해 1주 ‘52시간 상한제’ 예외를 두는 이른바 ‘화이트칼라 이그젬션’도 논의 대상에 포함하겠다고 했다.)

Han Byeong-do, Acting Leader and Floor Leader of the Democratic Party, who also serves as the Special Committee's chairperson, said in opening remarks at the committee's inaugural ceremony held at the National Assembly on the 10th, "We will communicate with government ministries in real-time and do our utmost to support the three major mega projects. We will decisively eliminate regulations that hinder these projects and operate a tailored legislative system to accelerate their progress." He added, "The party and the government share the goal of swiftly executing these projects, which will serve as a major transformation for building a future industrial ecosystem and achieving balanced national development." <<>> Kim Gyeong-soo, former Governor of South Gyeongsang Province, who will serve as Vice Chairperson of the Special Committee, stated, "The three major mega projects stand on the continuity and foundation of policies that the Democratic Party government has consistently promoted, such as informatization, fostering IT ventures, balanced regional development, the Digital New Deal, and expanding renewable energy. What we need to do now is quickly prepare the conditions that businesses require." He emphasized, "We must ensure that the National Assembly rapidly improves the system, including the Mega Special Zone Special Act, so that five bundled supports—talent, regulatory exemptions, R&D (research and development), fiscal and tax measures, and investment—can be provided swiftly." (3대 메가 프로젝트 특위 위원장을 맡고 있는 한병도 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 10일 국회에서 열린 특위 발대식 머리발언에서 “정부 부처와 실시간으로 소통하며 3대 메가 프로젝트를 뒷받침하는데 최선을 다하겠다”며 “메가 프로젝트의 발목을 잡는 규제를 과감히 타파하고 사업 추진에 속도를 높일 수 있도록 맞춤형 입법 체계를 가동하겠다”고 했다. 또한 “당정은 미래 산업 생태계 조성과 국가 균형 발전에 대전환이 될 이번 프로젝트를 속도감 있게 실행한다는 뜻을 공유하고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

Rep. Jang Cheol-min, who will serve as the Special Committee's secretary as the secretary of the National Assembly's Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs and Startups Committee, said, "We will not only draft detailed bills at the working level and provide full budgetary support but also quickly and clearly reach a consensus on social discussions for the project's success." In particular, Rep. Jang noted, "As it is a large-scale mega project, unprecedented incentives and bold regulatory exemptions, including a future 'White-Collar Exemption,' will be brought up for public debate. These are highly sensitive issues that will inevitably draw various opinions from labor circles and civil society, but we will never shy away from them." (특위 부위원장을 맡게 된 김경수 전 경남지사는 “3대 메가 프로젝트는 그동안 민주당 정부에서 꾸준히 추진해왔던 정보화, 아이티(IT) 벤처육성, 지혁균형 발전, 디지털 뉴딜, 재생에너지 확대라는 정책의 연속성과 그 토대 위에 서 있다”며 “지금 우리가 해야 할 일은 기업들이 필요로하는 조건을 빠르게 정비하는 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “인재·규제 특례·알앤디(R&D·연구개발)·재정 세제·투자 등 다섯 가지 패키지 지원이 발빠르게 지원될 수 있게 메가특구특별법을 포함한 제도 개선이 국회에서 신속하게 이뤄지도록 해야 한다”고 강조했다.)

After the closed-door meeting that day, Democratic Party spokesperson Park Kyung-mee told reporters, "There were suggestions to create the Mega Special Zone Special Act through a bottom-up approach (starting from detailed budget projects) rather than a top-down method, reflecting opinions from each region and area. Discussions also included the need to ensure that permits and approvals can be processed quickly." Regarding the White-Collar Exemption, she added, "The secretary (Rep. Jang Cheol-min) mentioned it in his opening remarks, but there was no specific discussion afterward." (국회 산업통상자원중소벤처기업위원회 간사로서 특위 간사를 맡게 된 장철민 의원은 “실무적 차원의 촘촘한 법안 발의와 예산 전폭 지원은 물론, 프로젝트 성공을 위한 사회적 논의를 신속하고 명확하게 합의해나갈 것”이라고 했다. 특히 장 의원은 “대규모 메가 프로젝트인 만큼, 향후 ‘화이트칼라 이그젬션’ 등을 포함해서 파격적인 인센티브와 과감한 규제 특례들이 공론화돼갈 것”이라며 “노동계나 시민사회 등 다양한 목소리가 나올 수밖에 없는 굉장히 민감한 이슈들이나, 결코 피하지 않겠다”고 했다.)

Along with former Governor Kim, Policy Committee Chairperson Han Jeong-ae and Rep. Eoh Eun-joo will serve as co-vice chairpersons of the Mega Special Committee. Lawmakers who are members of relevant standing committees and represent constituencies related to the project areas will participate as committee members. (이날 비공개 회의를 마친 뒤 박경미 민주당 대변인은 취재진에 “각 지역, 권역별 의견들을 반영해 탑다운(Top-Down)이 아니라 바텀업(Bottom-Up·세부 예산 사업부터 확정하는 방식) 방식으로 메가특구특별법을 만들자는 의견이 나왔다”며 “인허가가 스피디하게 이뤄질 수 있도록 하는 내용이 담겨야 한다는 이야기도 오갔다”고 했다. 화이트칼라 이그젬션과 관련해서는 “머리발언에서 간사(장철민 의원)의 발언이 있었는데, (이후에) 구체적인 논의가 있지는 않았다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Second comprehensive special counsel extended by 30 days... Bill passed through Legislation and Judiciary Committee's first subcommittee led by ruling party (2차 종합특검 30일 연장…여당 주도로 법안 법사위 1소위 통과)
item.description:
The National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee held a meeting of the First Subcommittee on Bill Review on the 10th and passed a bill to extend the investigation period of the second comprehensive special counsel by an additional 30 days. Lawmakers from the People Power Party were absent. (국회 법제사법위원회는 10일 법안심사제1소위원회를 열고 2차 종합특검의 수사 기간을 30일 추가로 연장하는 법안을 의결했다. 국민의힘 의원들은 불참했다.)

Kim Seung-won, a Democratic Party lawmaker who serves as the ruling party's representative on the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and chair of the First Subcommittee on Bill Review, met with reporters after the meeting and announced that the subcommittee had processed an amendment to the "Act on the Appointment of a Special Prosecutor to Investigate the Truth Behind the Insurrection, Treason, and Abuse of State Power by Yoon Seok-yeol and Kim Keon-hee," which was proposed separately by lawmakers Kang Deok-ku and Kim Seung-won. The special counsel's investigation deadline is currently set for the 24th, but if the amendment passes in the plenary session, the extension of 30 days will push the deadline to the 23rd of next month. (법사위 여당 간사이자 법안심사1소위원장인 김승원 더불어민주당 의원은 이날 회의 뒤 기자들과 만나 강득구·김승원 의원이 각각 대표 발의한 ‘윤석열·김건희에 의한 내란·외환 및 국정농단 행위의 진상규명을 위한 특별검사 임명 등에 관한 법률’ 개정안을 처리했다고 밝혔다. 특검의 수사 기한은 오는 24일까지인데, 본회의에서 개정안이 통과되면 30일이 추가 연장되면 다음달 23일로 늘어난다.)

In addition, the special counsel will be allowed to appoint lawyers with at least five years of legal experience to maintain prosecution. The scope of the investigation includes "obstruction of audits" by public officials. The Ministry of National Defense was added to the list of agencies from which the special counsel can request personnel, and the number of dispatched public officials was expanded from the current 130 to 150. (또 특검이 법조 경력이 5년 이상인 사람 중에서 공소유지 변호사를 임명할 수 있게 했다. 수사 대상에는 공무원의 ‘감사 방해’ 행위가 포함된다. 특검 파견 요청 기관에는 국방부를 추가하고, 파견 공무원 수는 기존 130명에서 150명으로 확대하기로 했다.)

The First Subcommittee on Bill Review was held on this day without the attendance of lawmakers from the People Power Party. (이날 법안심사 1소위는 국민의힘 소속 의원들이 불참한 가운데 진행됐다.)

Furthermore, the First Subcommittee on Bill Review also discussed amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act that include the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority. Kim Seung-won lawmaker said, "Today we received a report from the senior expert and read through it together with the committee members," adding, "You can consider this as the first step in revising the Criminal Procedure Act." He continued, "The lawmakers shared their concerns and initial thoughts with each other," and explained, "The subcommittee will hold about two more sessions starting next week, focusing on the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act." (아울러 법안심사 1소위는 이날 검사의 보완수사권 폐지가 담긴 형사소송법 개정안도 논의했다. 김승원 의원은 “오늘은 수석전문 위원의 보고를 받고 위원들과 함께 독해를 했다”면서 “아직 형소법 개정안 첫삽을 떳다고 보면 된다”라고 말했다. 이어 “의원님들께서 우려되는 상황이나 본인 생각 말씀해주셨고 의원님들이 가지고 있는 1차적인 생각들에 대해서는 서로 공유를 했다”며 “형사소송법 개정 중심으로 다음주 초 소위가 2번 정도 더 진행될 것”이라고 설명했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Former Lawmaker Chae Yi-bae Appointed as New Chief of Staff to Prime Minister Han Duck-soo (채이배 전 의원, 한성숙 신임 국무총리 비서실장에 임명)
item.description:
Former lawmaker Chae Yi-bae was appointed on the 10th as the new Chief of Staff (vice-minister level) to Prime Minister Han Duck-soo. (한성숙 국무총리를 보좌하는 신임 국무총리 비서실장(차관급)에 채이배 전 국회의원이 10일 임명됐다.)

The Prime Minister's Office announced in a press release on the same day, "Former Gyeonggi-do Job Foundation CEO Chae Yi-bae is scheduled to be appointed as the new Chief of Staff to the Prime Minister tomorrow (the 11th)." (국무총리실은 이날 보도자료를 내어 “신임 국무총리비서실장에 채이배 전 경기도일자리재단 대표이사가 내일(11일) 임명될 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

Chae, a former lawmaker, entered the 20th National Assembly in the 2016 general election as a proportional representative of the People's Party and served on the Political Affairs Committee and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee. He subsequently held roles such as Chair of the Policy Committee of the Bareunmirae Party, and joined the Democratic Party of Korea in December 2021, serving as an emergency response committee member. (채 전 의원은 2016년 총선 때 국민의당 소속 비례대표로 20대 국회에 입성해 20대 국회 정무위·법사위에서 활동했다. 이후 바른미래당 정책위의장 등을 역임했으며, 2021년 12월 더불어민주당에 입당해 비상대책위원을 지냈다.)

He has served as a secretary for the Economic Democratization Committee of the People's Solidarity for Participatory Democracy, a research fellow at the Institute for Good Corporate Governance and the Economic Reform Research Institute, as well as Special Advisor for Fair Economy to the Prime Minister, Chair of the Fair Market Committee for the Democratic Party's 20th Presidential Central Election Countermeasures Committee, and CEO of the Gyeonggi-do Job Foundation, an institution under the Gyeonggi Provincial Government. (참여연대 경제민주화위원회 간사, 좋은기업지배연구소 연구위원, 경제개혁연구소 연구위원을 지냈고 국무총리 공정경제특별보좌관, 민주당 제20대 대통령중앙선거대책위원회 공정시장위원장, 경기도 산하기관인 경기도일자리재단 대표이사를 역임했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "A party leader 200% in sync with the president is necessary… The previous way won't work" (김민석 “대통령과 합 200% 맞는 당대표 필요…그동안 방식 안 돼”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, former prime minister and candidate in the Democratic Party of Korea's leadership election, stated, "We need to elect a new leadership through this party convention, but when I think about whether it’s better to continue with the same method of leadership, direction, and line as before, my answer is no. It would be good to have 100% or 200% alignment with the president." (더불어민주당 당 대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리가 “이번 전당대회를 통해 새 지도부를 뽑아야 하는데, 그동안 했던 지도부와 지도력과 지도 노선의 방식으로 계속 가는 것이 더 나을까 (생각했을 때) 저는 아닌 것 같다”며 “대통령과 합이 100%, 200% 맞는 것이 좋다”고 말했다.)

The former prime minister made these remarks on the morning of the 10th while visiting the Democratic Party's Jeonju-gap district committee. He said, "Over the past year, the People Power Party, which had been unable to keep up at all, has now surpassed us, with some polls showing them winning by 1 or 2 percentage points. We need to seriously consider whether we can confidently maintain our current seats and win the next general election." (김 전 총리는 10일 오전 민주당 전주갑 지역위원회를 방문해 이렇게 말했다. 김 전 총리는 “지난 1년 동안 아예 쫓아오지도 못하던 국민의힘이 쫓아오는 걸 넘어서 일부 조사에서는 1%포인트, 2%포인트씩 이겨버리는 결과가 나오고 있다”며 “내일모레 총선을 치르면 우리가 자신 있게 현재 의석을 유지해 총선에 승리할 수 있을지를 심각하게 생각해봐야 한다”고 했다.)

Kim further stated, "If we become the ruling party, we must expand our base through alliances, integration, or recruitment. We need to show the public that we are still the dominant force, that the Lee Jae-myung government is unshaken and attracting talented people from all over. Only then can the government move forward without being shaken." He added, "I believe I am the best person to change the party's direction and work in that manner." (김 전 총리는 “여당이 됐으면 연대든, 통합이든, 영입이든 살을 찌워나가야 한다”며 “국민들이 볼 때 ‘아 저기가 여전히 대세구나’, ‘이재명 정부가 흔들리지 않고 천하의 인재들이 모여들고 있구나’ 하는 것을 보여줘야 한다. 그래야 정부가 흔들리지 않고 갈 수 있다”고 했다. 이어 “저는 그런 방식으로 당의 방향을 바꿔서 일을 해나가는 것을 제가 제일 잘할 수 있을 것 같다”고 했다.)

The former prime minister said, "The party needs to change to the point where it can compete in speed with the government. Over the past year, the party's focus and interests have been too narrow, but since we've mostly set our direction in that year, we need to truly sprint ahead." (김 전 총리는 “정부와 속도 경쟁을 하는 정도로 당이 바뀌어야 된다고 본다”며 “당이 지난 1년 동안 관심을 갖고 집중하는 주제가 너무 국한돼있었는데 1년 동안 거의 방향을 잡았기 때문에 진짜 속도전으로 뛰어야 한다”고 했다.)

On the same morning, Kim visited the Jeonbuk Provincial Office and held a meeting with Governor Lee Won-taek. (이날 오전 김 전 총리는 전북도청을 방문해 이원택 도지사와 면담을 하기도 했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)
